## Overview
### Introduction to OpenAI o1
The OpenAI o1 model, released on 2024-12-17, is a premium, non-open-source language model provided by OpenAI. This model boasts a robust architecture, with a context window of 200,000 tokens and a maximum output of 100,000 tokens. The knowledge cutoff for this model is 2023-10, ensuring it has a broad and up-to-date understanding of various subjects. OpenAI o1 is designed to handle complex tasks, leveraging its capabilities in text processing, function calling, structured outputs, streaming, batch processing, system prompts, and extended thinking.

### Technical Strengths and Use Cases
OpenAI o1 demonstrates exceptional performance across several benchmarks, including MMLU (92.3), HumanEval (94.4), LMSYS Arena ELO (1330), and GSM8K (99.5). These scores underscore its strengths in complex reasoning, math, science, coding, research, and PhD-level problems, making it an ideal choice for tasks such as legal analysis and financial modeling. However, it is not suited for simple tasks, high-volume applications, low-latency requirements, vision tasks, or budget-conscious projects. The pricing structure for OpenAI o1 includes $15.0 per 1M tokens for input, $60.0 per 1M tokens for output, with discounts for cached input and batch input at $7.5 per 1M tokens each.

For example, 1,000 calls with an average of 500 tokens would cost $37.5, scaling up to $375.0 for 10,000 calls and $3750.0 for 100,000 calls.
